title: Belt conveyor with margin, D-1 speed master, D-2 takes over on its loss
description: Plant a with the drives in a master-follower line (synthetic numbers): D-1 runs the speed loop and passes its reference to D-2, D-2 to D-3; when it is lost the followers keep their torque and D-2 takes the speed loop after 2 s.
stresses: load shared across drives on one belt: a failing drive moves load onto its peers, and a stop at the wrong moment strands a loaded belt
